These files are ioChem-BD's CML conversions (each item's output.cml, renamed here) of
Gaussian 16 calculations by Giovanni Occhipinti, Daniel L. Nascimento, Marco Foscato,
Deryn E. Fogg and Vidar R. Jensen, published with

  G. Occhipinti, D. L. Nascimento, M. Foscato, D. E. Fogg, V. R. Jensen, "The Janus face
  of high trans-effect carbenes in olefin metathesis: gateway to both productivity and
  decomposition", Chem. Sci. 2022, 13, 5107. doi:10.1039/D2SC00855F

Collection: beta_H_elimination_NHC_vs_CAAC, ioChem-BD, doi:10.19061/iochem-bd-6-113
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0),
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The files are unchanged; only their names differ.

File                                   Item (https://iochem-bd.bsc.es/browse/handle/...)
ts2prime-2_caac1_opt-freq.cml          100/199926  GeomOpt_PBEPBE, TS2'-2, CAAC1 (C1Ph)
ts2prime-2_caac1_sp-pbe-d3mbj.cml      100/199841  SP_PBEPBE_GD3MBJ_CHCl3, same structure
ts2prime-2_caac1_sp-m06l-d3.cml        100/199759  SP_M06L_GD3_CHCl3, same structure
ethylene_opt-freq.cml                  100/200014  GeomOpt_PBEPBE, ethylene
mcb-fragment-triplet_sp-pbe-d3mbj.cml  100/199849  SP_PBEPBE_GD3MBJ_CHCl3, triplet fragment
